description: Build the cartoon character. Look at the user photo and describe ONLY what is visible: hair length/style/color, fringe, glasses and frame style/color/pattern, skin tone, top style/color, button color. Do not invent traits. Returns a character sheet image.

name.description: The person's first name, shown on the sheet.

notes.description: Details you noticed that traits cannot express yet (they guide future versions).

photoPath.description: Local path to the uploaded photo (copied into the project).

bottom.description: Trousers or skirt color (guess something neutral if not visible).

bangs.description: side = swept fringe, straight = blunt fringe, none = forehead visible / center part.

style.description: long = past the shoulders, bob = jaw to shoulder length, short = above the ears, bun = tied up, curly = big curly or afro volume, buzz = very short.

skin.description: Skin tone preset or hex color.

button.description: Button color for shirts, if visible.

style.description: shirt = collared shirt or blouse with buttons.

name: create_character
title: Create the character from a photo
